verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Sketch supports named color variables, since AI can generate a palette of them from a photo. It also offers an AI-driven swap of light-mode components for dark-mode counterparts, and it can recreate text styles and colors from a repo. These are glancing mentions tied to AI features, not documentation of native token or variable management with modes. missing for 10: native variable collections with modes/themes, spacing and typography variables, documented theme switching across designs outside of AI, independent corroboration.
